sourceNotes: Values are approximate representative placeholders for ruleset tuning, not a clinical nutrient database.

sections.title: Fats
sections.narration: 47.4 grams of fat. Polyunsaturated fat is 14.4 grams, the best number here but still only modest help. Omega 3 is 80 milligrams, not adding much omega 3, so that's a real downside for seeds. For seeds, fat quality is a big reason to use them.

sections.title: Carbs
sections.narration: 15.3 grams of carbs. Sugar is 0.5 grams, helping keep the sugar load under control. Starch is 1 gram, not bringing much steady carb energy, so that's a small downside for seeds. For seeds, fibre matters much more than raw carb totals.
